name: Local collection persistence
setup: Define entity type + parse(raw) => T | null for one array item. createCollectionStore({ key, parse }) for persistence; useCollection(store) in React.
tiny_example:
const store = createCollectionStore<Book>({ key: "books", parse: parseBook });
const { items, add, update, remove } = useCollection(store);
use_when: simple CRUD over a flat list keyed by id
constraints: Use this as the persistence boundary.
Do not add repository/service wrapper layers unless the domain is not a flat collection.
Storage resolves lazily (Exp5b); pass createMemoryStorage() in tests.
test_hint: In tests: createCollectionStore({ key: "test", parse, storage: createMemoryStorage() }). Do not mock localStorage by hand.
